brief.problem_or_goal: Discuss the observed performance differences between a merged LLM (FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview) and another model (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B), based on user-reported tests.
brief.context: A user on r/LocalLLaMA shared their experience with a new merged model, FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview, highlighting its performance on specific tasks compared to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B. The user's tests involved a file-packing problem, a date difference calculation, and a river crossing riddle.
brief.motivation: Understanding how model merging impacts performance on specific tasks is crucial for users looking to optimize their local LLM setups. This discussion aims to explore the user's findings and encourage further investigation into the effectiveness of merged models.
brief.desired_response: A discussion about the user's observations regarding the FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview model, comparing its performance on the presented tasks to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and considering the implications of model merging.
brief.speaker_relationship_to_source: reader of archived source; no claim of personally running reported tests

facts.text: The FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview model is a Fusion (merge) of DeepSeekR1, QwQ, and SkyT1 32B models.
facts.evidence_quote: This model is a Fusion(merge?) of DeepSeekR1 & QwQ & SkyT1 32B models.

facts.text: The user's test setup included ollama + IQ4_XS + 32k context + Q8_0 KV Cache.
facts.evidence_quote: My test setup is ollama + IQ4\_XS + 32k context + Q8\_0 KV Cache

facts.text: For a file-packing problem, the FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview model provided four correct answers, which the user found amazing.
facts.evidence_quote: This is first time I saw a local model give me 4 correct answers for this question, it's amazing

facts.text: For a date difference calculation between 12-12-1971 and 18-4-2024, the FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview model correctly calculated 19,121 days.
facts.evidence_quote: The number of days between December 12, 1971, and April 18, 2024, is 19,121 days . This calculation includes the full years, accounts for leap years, and considers the days in the partial years, providing the difference between the two dates.

facts.text: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B model provided an incorrect answer of 19,486 for the date difference calculation.
For a river crossing riddle, the FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview model provided a solution that the user considered correct, involving a single trip.
facts.evidence_quote: which is the correct answer, they only need to cross the river once

facts.text: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B model entered an infinite loop when attempting the river crossing riddle.
facts.evidence_quote: *fell into an infinite loop, I had to terminate it*
